{{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Incantation Spell}}''' - Spawns a [[Healing Beacon]]. |ability1_cooldown = 6 |ability1_starting_cooldown = 6 }} ==Description== The '''Void Cultist''' is a support enemy that appears in both [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has decent health and slightly slow speed. It has one ability where it will summon a [[Healing Beacon]] on the path that heals any enemy it passes through by 675 every 0.1 seconds. This [[Healing Beacon]] lasts 6 seconds and, once gone, the '''Void Cultist''' will wait around 6 seconds more before summoning another one. ==Logbook Description== "''The Void Cultist is a specialized Odd who found purpose in the Void. When their realms were being destroyed, they welcomed the end with open arms. For that, the Void rewarded them and Void Caster turned them into the Void Cultist. They preach the whispers of the Void and hold ceremonies for the army to partake in. Where others in the army were taken by the Void, the Cultists chose it, and they carry that distinction with quiet pride. Their devotion is expressed not through combat but through care, mending their fellow followers so that the army may march on. They are pacifists by conviction, and they chose to keep it that way.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Cultist''' has a black body. It wears a purple robe with a gold and purple cape and purple hood. It has a few purple and gold thorns coming out of its back. It has a gold and purple mask with multiple flowers covering its face. It will occasionally summon incantation circles around itself when using its ability. ==Strategy== *It is important to focus best on taking down the '''Void Cultist''' as soon as possible when it spawns. While their [[Healing Beacon]]s cannot damage your base, they can rapidly heal enemies within those beacons. **Setting the targeting to some of your towers on ''Last Enemy'', especially those of higher DPS, can help take down the '''Void Cultists''' as fast as possible, as they usually spawn in the back. **If you have the [[Gatling Gun]], you can freely focus on the '''Void Cultist(s)''' when in ''FPS'' mode, even if there are nearby enemies with [[Aggro]]. **If you have a [[Saboteur]] that is at least at Level 3, you can use its ''Aggressive Toxins'' ability on the '''Void Cultist(s)''' to force nearby towers to target them, even if other nearby enemies have [[Aggro]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.2.0GenericThumbnail15.png|'''Void Cultist''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidCultistCA.jpg|'''Void Cultist''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidCultistIconIG.png|'''Void Cultist''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Cultist''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Cultist''' added, replacing the [[Health Cultist]]. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health decreased from 25,000 to 20,000 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. {{Hardcore|[[Soul]] & [[Slow King]]|Wave 37|Void Cultist|Wave 38|[[Speedy King]]|Wave 39}} {{Voidcore|[[Vindicator]]|Wave 43|[[Unknown Boss]] & Void Cultist|Wave 44|[[Soul Stealer]]|Wave 45}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
